messages:
maria gonzalez: kicking off a quick sync on the partner escalation drill next wed. goal: validate shared channel + fallback war room. cc @priya @ben
ben thorpe: sounds good. what time? prefer mid-day for APAC overlap
priya rao: we should include SI oncall + hw partner POC. Also confirm SRE bridge owner. propose 15:00 UTC
samir ullah: :thumbsup: 15:00 UTC works. I'll own the war room config and the alert routing checks.
maria gonzalez: thanks. agenda: 1) create shared #partner-warroom-<id> channel (read-only for partners) 2) run simulated sev (page->channel->bridge) 3) test fallback to email + phone tree 4) capture gaps in runbook
ben thorpe: for channel policies: partners get post perms only after validation. For the drill, give them a /sim-post role.
priya rao: I pushed an initial runbook draft here: https://redwood.atlassian.com/display/PARTNERS/partner-sev-drill-v1 — can everyone review before EOD tmrw? main areas: contact matrix, auth for partner posts, IAM tokens for private deployments.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled drill created: /remind #partnerships in 2 days at 15:00 UTC — created by maria gonzalez
samir ullah: snippet for channel creation I'll run: ```bash
slack-cli create-channel --name partner-warroom-2026-03-25 --private true --invites maria_g ben_t priya_r
```
priya rao: we should also simulate model fallback routing - e.g., if hosted capacity goes down, SIs should see clear 'degraded' banner. Can we add a quick mock to the runbook?
maria gonzalez: agree. add a 'who does what' table and add SLA thresholds that trigger partner escalation.
ben thorpe: I'll coordinate with HW partner POC, Jason L. to get phone numbers. @maria can you add a line for 'no-response escalates to CS lead after 10 mins'?
maria gonzalez: added. Also planning a 15-min retro after drill. Keep it tight.
samir ullah: on the day I'll run a pre-check script 10 mins before: `curl -X GET https://internal/redwood-health/partners_check`
ops-bot: Event: channel partner-warroom-2026-03-25 created by samir ullah. Members invited: maria gonzalez, ben thorpe, priya rao, jason_l (external).
priya rao: one more ask: capture screenshots of partner permission flows and post them to the runbook during the drill.
ben thorpe: ack. I'll add contact card for hardware partner: jason.l@examplehw.com, +1-415-555-0199
maria gonzalez: OK wrapping up — action items: priya: review runbook; ben: confirm POC contacts; samir: war room infra; i'll send calendar invite. Thanks :raised_hands:
